## Exercise 7

The analyst's plot:

```{python}
monthly = (hotels
           .groupby("arrival_date_month", as_index=False)
           .agg(mean_adr=("adr", "mean")))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
ax.bar(monthly["arrival_date_month"], monthly["mean_adr"],
       color=["red", "green"] * 6)
ax.set_ylim(60, 145)
ax.set_title("PRICES EXPLODE IN THE SUMMER!!!")
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
```
